'''Revar ''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was the commander of the [[Leth Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he asked an Imperial to help defend the outpost against the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
